title: Sample contract templates

success: Deployed. The network accepted your contract.
invalidAddress: Enter a wallet address that starts with 0x.

escrow.title: Escrow
escrow.description: A buyer deposits PPL for a seller. A neutral arbiter can release the funds to the seller or refund the buyer; the buyer can also release early. Supports either native PPL or a test stablecoin (tUSDC/tUSDT).

vesting.title: Vesting timelock
vesting.description: Locks PPL for one beneficiary and releases it in a straight line between a start time and an end time.

crowdfund.title: Crowdfund
crowdfund.description: Collects PPL toward a goal before a deadline. The owner claims the funds if the goal is met; contributors get a refund if it isn't. Supports either native PPL or a test stablecoin (tUSDC/tUSDT).

erc20.title: Fixed-supply token
erc20.description: A simple ERC-20 token with a fixed supply, minted entirely to the deployer at creation.

fields.start: Start time (defaults to now, unix seconds)
fields.name: Token name

faucetLimitHint: Limit: up to 1,000 tokens per 24 hours.
faucetCooldown: You've reached the 24-hour faucet limit. Try again later.
approveDepositLead: Two wallet transactions: approve the token, then deposit.
depositComplete: Deposited. The escrow now holds the funds.
